questions.contextText:
Comprehension Passage – I (Questions 41 – 45): Read the following passage carefully and
answer the questions that follow.
Urban wetland ecosystems—ranging from floodplain marshes to peri-urban lakes—function as
indispensable ecological infrastructure for rapidly expanding cities. Acting as natural sponges,
wetlands absorb excess monsoon runoff during cloudbursts, mitigating catastrophic urban flooding
while recharging depleted municipal aquifers. Simultaneously, dense aquatic vegetation and
benthic microbial communities filter heavy metals, agricultural nitrates, and suspended pollutants,
purifying surface water before it enters downstream rivers. Despite these vital ecosystem services,
short-sighted real-estate encroachment, solid-waste dumping, and untreated sewage discharge
have obliterated over half of Asia's urban wetlands in recent decades. Safeguarding surviving urban
wetlands demands stringent legal demarcation of buffer zones, decentralised sewage treatment,
and participatory stewardship by local citizen collectives.
questions.questionText: How do urban wetlands help prevent catastrophic flooding during heavy monsoon cloudbursts?
options: By diverting all rainwater directly into deep-sea trenches
By acting as natural sponges that absorb excess runoff and recharge aquifers
By increasing surface temperatures to accelerate atmospheric evaporation
By replacing natural river channels with concrete storm drains

ବର୍ତ୍ତିକା ସଦୃଶ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ । ପୁସ୍ତକ ପାଠ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମନୁଷ୍ୟର ଚିନ୍ତାଶକ୍ତି ବିକଶିତ ହୁଏ, ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଭଙ୍ଗୀ ଉଦାର ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ନୈତିକ ଚରିତ୍ର
ଗଠନ ହୋଇଥାଏ । ଆଧୁନିକ ଯୁଗରେ ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ଓ ସାମାଜିକ ଗଣମାଧ୍ୟମର ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବ ଯୋଗୁଁ ଯୁବପିଢ଼ିଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପୁସ୍ତକ
ପଠନର ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କ୍ରମଶଃ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇବାରେ ଲାଗିଛି, ଯାହା ଏକ ଚିନ୍ତାଜନକ ବିଷୟ । ତେଣୁ ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ଓ ଗ୍ରାମାଞ୍ଚଳରେ ପାଠାଗାର
ଆନ୍ଦୋଳନକୁ ପୁନର୍ଜୀବିତ କରିବା ସହିତ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ନିୟମିତ ପୁସ୍ତକ ପଠନ ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ସାହିତ କରିବା ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଜରୁରୀ ।
